pb-youtube-board.title: Review outputs
pb-youtube-board.handoff: These are editor instructions and publishing text. Finish the video in your editor, then post it yourself.
pb-youtube-board.optionalPlatforms: Leave a platform blank to skip it. Preparing again clears the output decisions.
pb-youtube-board.desktop: Open the desktop app for a project folder.
pb-youtube-board.saveHelp: Approve or discard every output. Saving asks where to put a new folder and leaves existing folders alone.
pb-youtube-board.countHelp: Counted by code from the saved text. Save edits to refresh the count.
pb-youtube-board.requestHelp: This records your request. Apply the edit or change the text, then prepare and review again.
pb-youtube-board.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This could not be completed. Open the board again and try once more.
pb-youtube-board.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The board changed. Read the current outputs before approving.
pb-youtube-board.error.DERIVED_STALE: The source or edit changed. Prepare these outputs again.
pb-youtube-board.error.MEDIA_FILE_REQUIR: Record the local footage path on this order first.
pb-youtube-board.error.OUTPUT_APPROVAL_R: Approve or discard each exact output first.
pb-youtube-board.error.EXPORT_EXISTS: That project folder already exists. Choose another location.
pb-youtube-board.error.EXPORT_NOT_SAVED: The project could not be saved there. Choose another folder.
pb-youtube-board.error.PUBLISHING_TEXT_I: Choose a platform and keep its publishing text within the shown limit.
pb-youtube-board.error.BROLL_REVIEW_REQU: Approve the b-roll plan and review every frame grid first.
pb-youtube-board.error.BROLL_APPROVAL_RE: Review and approve the exact b-roll plan first.
pb-youtube-board.error.FINISHING_FAILED: Fix the finishing findings before exporting.
pb-youtube-board.error.CLIP_RULES_FAILED: Fix the clip boundary and length findings before exporting.
pb-youtube-board.error.BEAT_RULES_FAILED: Fix speaking times and the loop before exporting.
pb-youtube-board.error.TIER_UNAVAILABLE: This action needs the desktop app. Use your own editor meanwhile.
pb-youtube-board.error.MEDIA_TOOL_UNAVAI: Install ffmpeg yourself to measure local footage. Chausar does not install it.
pb-youtube-board.error.LOCAL_APP_NOT_FOU: This editor is not installed. Install it yourself and try again.
pb-youtube-board.error.RIGHTS_REQUIRED: Record your rights to use this footage first.
pb-youtube-board.error.INTERCHANGE_INVAL: The editor file is not a supported, valid cut list.
pb-youtube-board.error.INTERCHANGE_UNSUP: Use a flat video cut list without effects, gaps or retiming.
pb-youtube-board.loop: Loop back to this opening line
pb-youtube-board.clipHelp: The opening text stays for two seconds. The loop returns to the first selected word.
pb-youtube-board.chooseAsset: Choose an owned or licensed asset
pb-youtube-board.brollHelp: Read these exact placements before approving. Every file also needs your frame-grid review. No automatic detector ran.
pb-youtube-board.gridAlt: Frames from the approved supporting clip
pb-youtube-board.noDetector: Look at the frames and answer every question. No automatic detector ran.
pb-youtube-board.question.burnedCaptions: Are captions already burned into the image?
pb-youtube-board.question.lowerThirds: Are another creator’s lower-third labels visible?
pb-youtube-board.editorHelp: Advanced: use the public command documented by your installed editor. Review the full command before running it.
pb-youtube-board.returnedHelp: Paste the FCPXML from your editor. This only reports differences and changes no edit.
pb-youtube-board.finishingHelp: Local ffmpeg measures frames and sound. Enter your text boxes and commentary duration. Safe margins are house prechecks; inspect the platform preview yourself. Face detection is not available.
pb-youtube-board.styleHelp: Select two or three of your own videos with saved local paths. Completed local scans measure pace, cuts and loudness. Face share stays unmeasured without an installed detector.
pb-youtube-board.styleDifference: More than a quarter from the reference
pb-youtube-board.finding.BEAT_TOO_LONG: A spoken beat is too long.
pb-youtube-board.finding.LOOP_MISSING: The loop does not return to the opening line.
pb-youtube-board.finding.CLIP_SENTENCE: Start and end on complete sentences.
pb-youtube-board.finding.CLIP_DURATION: The clip is outside the duration range.
pb-youtube-board.finding.CLIP_HOOK: Use a hook of at most eight words.
pb-youtube-board.finding.CLIP_OVERLAY: Keep the opening text for two seconds.
pb-youtube-board.finding.CLIP_LOOP: Return the loop to the first word.
pb-youtube-board.clipPageHelp: Record only details you know. The page is a local draft for your approval; no page is published.
pb-youtube-board.page.name: Clip page name
pb-youtube-board.audioHelp: Choose one local file or one public media address. Sources are limited to 500 MB and extracted audio to twenty minutes. Nothing goes to a speech provider. Install ffmpeg yourself; Chausar does not bundle it.
pb-youtube-board.counterHelp: Only numbers found in the recorded spoken words are listed. Timing comes from those words.
pb-youtube-board.legibility.warn: Text is below the house warning size. Target pixels:
pb-youtube-board.legibility.review: Review text below the house target. Target pixels:
pb-youtube-board.legibility.pass: Text meets the house size target. Target pixels:
pb-youtube-board.error.SOURCE_DOWNSCALED: Use source footage that meets the delivery resolution.
pb-youtube-board.error.CLIP_PAGE_INVALID: Check the recorded clip page details.
pb-youtube-board.error.AUDIO_INPUT_INVAL: Choose one local file or one public media address.
pb-youtube-board.error.AUDIO_TOO_LARGE: The source exceeds the audio size limit.
pb-youtube-board.finishingChanged: Video details changed. Measure again before saving.
